name: tabs
description: CSS-only tab panels using the radio-button trick. No JavaScript required. Use {{< tabs >}} as container and {{< tab 'Label' >}} for each panel.

usage.note: First tab is automatically selected (checked) by default

css.note: Override to restyle tabs. Or add rules in main.css targeting .mdf-tabs, .mdf-tab-label, .mdf-tab-content.

locked.reason: No locked contracts — pure CSS implementation, fully overridable

css_in_main.note: Override individual classes in main.css with higher specificity

partials.note: Override the container shortcode to change wrapper structure
Override the tab shortcode. Keep .mdf-tab-toggle (radio) + .mdf-tab-label + .mdf-tab-content structure for CSS to work.
